key_findings: Gate label: HOLD_ARXIV_FOR_OTL, scoped only to C3. Release conditions (any one): (a) OTL intake completed and cleared or provisional filed; (b) documented informed PI/author decision to proceed without filing; (c) confirmation shield concept already public via earlier channel (G10).

Timeline: figures 2026-06-11..26; final TeX edit+compile 2026-07-02 14:03-14:04 local; submission.pdf (Aspose, journal portal) 2026-07-02; cover letter affirms no preprint posted as of that date. Biggest unknowns: G10 earliest shield disclosure; current IEEE review status.

Key analysis: arXiv adds no NEW technical disclosure beyond the journal submission (shield concept is the same one sentence in both) - the arXiv decision is about acceleration and irrevocability of the public-disclosure trigger, not about new content. Journal publication will eventually start the same clock.
MPEP 2153.01(a) authorship/inventorship nuance flagged: six authors vs potentially narrower inventor list could complicate reliance on the US grace period ('additional evidence' scenario).

IEEE policy verified (direct fetch): arXiv posting permitted before/during/after submission, not prior publication; at acceptance must replace with DOI citation or copyright-noticed accepted version. IEEE side is NOT a reason to hold.
